meta.title: Cookbook (Demo)
meta.description: Store your recipes in your WordPress, with ingredients, steps, and prep/cook times. Pre-loaded with two recipes fetched live from the web so you can explore right away.
meta.author: Alex Kirk

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( ! post_type_exists( 'cb-recipes' ) || ! class_exists( '\\Cookbook\\Importer' ) || ! class_exists( '\\Cookbook\\ServiceContainer' ) ) {
	return;
}

$owner = get_user_by( 'login', 'admin' );
$owner_id = $owner ? $owner->ID : 1;
$recipe_service = \Cookbook\ServiceContainer::default()->recipes();

$urls = [
	9001 => 'https://www.gutekueche.at/marillenknoedel-mit-topfenteig-rezept-784',
	9002 => 'https://www.gutekueche.at/cremige-schinkenfleckerln-rezept-23978',
];

foreach ( $urls as $import_id => $url ) {
	$parsed = \Cookbook\Importer::from_url( $url );
	if ( ! $parsed ) {
		continue;
	}

	$post_id = wp_insert_post( [
		'import_id'    => $import_id,
		'post_type'    => 'cb-recipes',
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
		'post_title'   => $parsed['title'] ?: __( 'Imported recipe', 'cookbook' ),
		'post_content' => $parsed['description'] ?? '',
		'post_author'  => $owner_id,
	], true );

	if ( is_wp_error( $post_id ) ) {
		continue;
	}

	$recipe_service->apply_parsed_payload( (int) $post_id, $parsed, $url, false );
}
